pairs.l: 1  I’m ill in bed with the flu. Please call Mr. Smith and tell him I can’t see him in the afternoon.
2  We’ll be out all day relaxing in the fresh air. Bring some sandwiches in case you get hungry.
3  Don’t worry about the test. You’ve done lots of exercises. I’m sure you’ll do fine. Take it easy.
4  I hear you want to lose some weight. Stop talking about it and join me at the gym this afternoon.
5  Don’t ask me why your Mum and Dad cancelled the trip. You should discuss it with them.

r1.exp: 1→B (bolestan, otkaži sastanak), 2→A (ponesi sendviče = Take some food), 3→F (ne brini, opusti se = Relax), 4→E (pođi u teretanu = Get some exercise), 5→D (razgovaraj s roditeljima). C suvišan.

r6.exp: “Normally my Dad drives me to school” → obično ide autom (by car). Danas nije mogao jer je otac na putu.

r7.exp: “Why don’t you come round to my house and we can go there together?” → sastajalište = Brynova kuća (his place).

r8.exp: “I’ll just look for my old dancing shoes and get into the rhythm.” → ples (dancing). Gitarska klasa je popunjena.

r9.exp: “Can you send me the answers so I don’t have a problem at school tomorrow?” → Tom želi da mu Paul da odgovore (do his homework).

r10.exp: Party u 9, Jennifer želi doći 15 min. kasno, pa krece od kuće u 8:45 (“at a quarter to nine”). Odlazi oko 11.

r11.exp: “Leona, Lennie to her friends and family” → nadimak = Lennie.

r12.exp: “At the age of 27, she is not only a successful ballet dancer” → ima 27 godina. Prihvatljivo: 27 / twenty-seven.

r13.exp: “a successful ballet dancer with the Royal Ballet” → profesija = balerina. Prihvatljivo: ballet dancer / ballerina / dancer.

r14.exp: “I needed something to get rid of the stress” → našla je vrtlarenje. Prihvatljivo: gardening / writing.

r15.exp: “His favourites [were tulips], but I’ve always liked roses best.” → omiljeno cvijeće = ruže. Prihvatljivo: rose / roses.

pairs.r: E — after a few days because you have a busy social life
D — that have classified job ads for teenagers
C — how to prepare for interviews to get them
A — why they should hire you for the job
B — you might be able to turn it into a career

r16.exp: 16→E (ne odustaj nakon par dana zbog društvenog života), 17→D (web stranice s oglasima za tinejdžere), 18→C (savjeti za pripremanje intervjua), 19→A (reci zašto bi te trebali zaposliti), 20→B (možeš od toga napraviti karijeru). F suvišan.

r21.exp: Nerestrikivna relativna rečenica: “which” se odnosi na cijelu prethodnu rečenicu (zaboravila telefon = to je razljutilo mamu).

r22.exp: “Go to [a place]” = ići u (neko mjesto). Fiksna prepozicija uz ‘go’.

r23.exp: Prošlo jednostavno (past simple) za završenu radnju jučer. “In the afternoon we visited”.

r24.exp: “We don’t have to wear them” = ne moramo ih nositi (15. stoljećnu odjeću). ‘Wear’ = odijevati/nositi.

r25.exp: “Such an exhausting day” — pridjevi koji počinju samoglasnikom zahtijevaju ‘an’. ‘Such an’ ispred imenice.

r26.exp: “For a few years” = nekoliko godina. ‘A few’ + množina za mali broj.

r27.exp: Relativna rečenica za mjesto: “at the Research Centre where he worked” = u istraživačkom centru gdje je radio.

r28.exp: “Looked like a tail” = izgledalo kao rep. Fiksna kolokacija ‘look like’.

r30.exp: “The same in most languages” = jednako u većini jezika. Prepozicija ‘in’ uz ‘languages’.

sol.ans: Referentni odgovor mora: (1) opisati što je učenik radio prošlog vikenda, (2) navesti najljepšu stvar i objasniti zašto, (3) opisati planove za sljedeći vikend. 50–70 riječi, neformalan ton.

pairs.r: A — You don’t have to come.

l1.exp: 1→E (ne mogu doći), 2→F (možda ću kasniti), 3→A (ne moraš doći), 4→C (moraš doći), 5→D (možeš doći). B suvišan.

l6.exp: Studenti planiraju navečer posjetiti prijatelja (visit a friend).

l8.exp: Sastaju se navečer u trgovačkom centru (shopping mall).

l12.exp: Dvoranska liga je za dječake mlađe od 19 godina.

l13.exp: Bob trenira u sportskom klubu (sports club).

l14.exp: Bobova sljedeća utakmica je u srijedu (Wednesday).

l17.exp: Brent kanal izgrađen je za vojnu obranu (military defence).

l18.exp: Turisti idu u Glennis Park gledati zalazak sunca (sunset).

l19.exp: Vodič traži da turisti ponesu bon za večeru (dinner coupon).
